name: Absolute Cinema
message: Treat an event as an outstanding piece of entertainment, sincerely or with playful exaggeration.
relational_pattern: Ordinary events are elevated into a grand spectacle.

name: This Is Fine
message: Maintain a facade of calm while circumstances are visibly falling apart.
relational_pattern: Claimed wellbeing contradicts obvious surrounding trouble.

name: Monkey Puppet
message: React awkwardly while trying not to reveal knowledge or involvement.
relational_pattern: The observer has a reason to avoid attention.

name: Sad Pablo Escobar
message: Show lonely waiting, boredom, or an anticlimactic absence of activity.
relational_pattern: Expected company or stimulation is missing.

name: Hide the Pain Harold
message: Keep a strained pleasant expression despite internal discomfort.
relational_pattern: Public politeness conceals private suffering.

name: Laughing Leo
message: Offer amused, smug disbelief at a statement or outcome.
relational_pattern: An observer finds a claim or irony particularly entertaining.

name: Leonardo DiCaprio Cheers
message: Acknowledge a win or a clever remark with a composed celebratory toast.
relational_pattern: An observer gives stylish recognition without a long speech.

name: Waiting Skeleton
message: Exaggerate how long an anticipated response or event is taking.
relational_pattern: A supposedly brief delay stretches beyond patience.

name: Squidward Window
message: Look on wistfully while others enjoy something you are excluded from.
relational_pattern: An observer watches other people have the desired experience.

name: Charlie Conspiracy
message: Dramatize an elaborate explanation built from many connected details.
relational_pattern: A sprawling theory is offered with intense conviction.

name: Spider-Man Pointing
message: Recognize matching identities, behaviour, or mutual accusations.
relational_pattern: Two parties mirror the same relevant property.

name: It's a Trap!
message: Warn that an apparently attractive invitation has a hidden downside.
relational_pattern: A tempting offer conceals a catch.

name: Ain't Nobody Got Time for That
message: Reject an activity because it is not worth the effort or time.
relational_pattern: A requested effort exceeds willingness to engage.

name: Do You Want Ants?
message: Point out that someone's behaviour invites the predictable problem they want to avoid.
relational_pattern: Carelessness creates its own foreseeable consequence.

name: Life Finds a Way
message: Marvel at something persisting or succeeding despite obstacles.
relational_pattern: An unlikely path emerges after obvious paths are blocked.

name: Milk Was a Bad Choice
message: Admit regret after an ill-judged choice backfires.
relational_pattern: The actor recognizes their own decision was the mistake.

name: It Ain't Much, But It's Honest Work
message: Take modest pride in a small but useful contribution.
relational_pattern: A humble result is worthwhile despite its limited scale.

name: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
message: Rationalize keeping or indulging in something one intended to give up.
relational_pattern: Desire quietly rewrites a prior commitment.

name: What's in the Box?
message: Exaggerate suspense or anxious curiosity about hidden contents.
relational_pattern: Something withheld becomes the focus of intense anticipation.

name: I Was Told There Would Be Cake
message: Complain that an advertised benefit or incentive never materialized.
relational_pattern: Participation was motivated by an expectation that was not met.

name: I Am the Captain Now
message: Announce taking control or reversing the usual hierarchy.
relational_pattern: The previously subordinate party claims authority.

name: A Center for Ants?
message: Mock something being far smaller than its intended purpose requires.
relational_pattern: The offered scale is absurdly inadequate.

name: You Were the Chosen One!
message: Express theatrical disappointment when a trusted hope becomes part of the problem.
relational_pattern: The expected solution betrays the role assigned to it.

name: I Feel Like I'm Taking Crazy Pills
message: Express disbelief that everyone else is accepting an obvious absurdity.
relational_pattern: One observer cannot reconcile a group's consensus with what seems apparent.

name: You Sit on a Throne of Lies
message: Playfully reject an obviously dubious claim.
relational_pattern: Confident words conflict with evidence already available to the group.

name: Stop Trying to Make Fetch Happen
message: Push back on someone repeatedly trying to force an idea or phrase into acceptance.
relational_pattern: Persistence has become an attempt to manufacture agreement.

name: First Try!
message: Celebrate a success, potentially while jokingly hiding all the failed attempts.
relational_pattern: The visible success conceals a less glamorous attempt history.

name: Michael Scott No God No
message: Reject unwelcome news with exaggerated dread.
relational_pattern: An anticipated inconvenience provokes a theatrical negative reaction.

name: Shut Up and Take My Money!
message: Express immediate enthusiasm for a product or proposal.
relational_pattern: Desire is strong enough that further persuasion is unnecessary.

name: Facepalm
message: React with embarrassed exasperation to an avoidable mistake.
relational_pattern: An obvious error is difficult to watch without reacting.
